content.short: INIT Capital is a liquidity hook money market on Mantle designed to bootstrap liquidity for DeFi protocols.
content.description:
INIT Capital is an innovative decentralized money market built on the Mantle network, featuring a unique "Liquidity Hook" architecture. This design allows other DeFi protocols to integrate directly with INIT to access concentrated liquidity, streamlining the process of bootstrapping new financial applications. Users can manage multiple independent siloed positions, enabling sophisticated lending and borrowing strategies while maintaining precise risk control.

Deeply integrated with the Mantle ecosystem, INIT Capital supports high-yield strategies for assets like mETH and USDe. The protocol serves as a core infrastructure layer, providing the liquidity needed for developers to build complex LSDFi products and for users to maximize their capital efficiency. Through its commitment to interoperability and community-driven growth, INIT Capital is a key pillar of the decentralized economy on Mantle.
content.meta: INIT Capital provides specialized liquidity hooks and decentralized lending services on the Mantle network.
